title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #086 · 광택 소재 믹스 · 부채꼴·물결 · 5영역(루비 에나멜+에메랄드 에나멜+티타늄 무지개+로즈골드 박+미러 크롬) · 풀커버 · apex siren · 와이드 스탠스 · Indian · 배경 검정 스튜디오 · 브리티시 모드
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, apex siren physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered rose pink hair — her body is covered in 5 different shiny materials at once, each material claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 53% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 5 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 10'clock, 12'clock, 4'clock, 6'clock and 8'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 10 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries deep ruby-red high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 2 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries emerald-green high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 3 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 6 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries anodised titanium in iridescent blue, violet and gold bands, a metallic oxide shimmer. Region 4 is the wedge between the 6 o'clock ray and the 8 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied rose-gold leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright rose-gold sheen. Region 5 is the wedge between the 8 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries mirror chrome paint, a seamless liquid-mirror coat reflecting the light in sharp bright highlights. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring materials blend along the edge: the edge of one reaches into the other and the two simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, every material laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: standing in a wide stance facing the camera straight on, both hands resting on her flared hips, her legs fully in view — most extreme apex siren silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy olive green leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in olive green lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a pure black studio void with soft key light shaping her body, nothing else in frame. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
